atom.def: The smallest piece of an element that still has that element's properties.

element.def: A substance made of only one kind of atom, such as carbon or oxygen.

periodic-table.def: The chart of every element in order, giving each one's symbol and atomic mass.

molecule.def: A group of atoms held together as one unit, such as a water molecule, H₂O.

compound.def: A substance made of two or more elements joined in a fixed ratio.

atomic-mass-unit.def: A unit of mass for atoms: one twelfth of the mass of a carbon-12 atom.

atomic-mass.def: The mass of an atom of an element in atomic mass units, as listed on the periodic table.

mole.def: The counting unit of chemistry: 6.022 × 10²³ particles of whatever you name.

avogadro.def: 6.022 × 10²³, the number of particles in one mole.

molar-mass.def: The mass of one mole of a substance, in grams per mole (g/mol).
